'''''Gem of Alderaan''''' was a luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] that was owned by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Alya Aldrete]]'s [[Aldrete family|family]]. It was launched on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in what was a major event, attended by various celebrities and wealthy people. It was attacked during the event by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], but they were defeated by a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] fighters.
